notes.title: v1.1 Update
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751171/1fe3b67c3e48b92f6c4ba617d8d9706a36de2dec.jpg"][/img][/p][p]\[b]Update 1.1\[/b] is live! 

This update adds a few requested features, quality-of-life improvements, and some cleanup behind the scenes.[/p][p]\[b]**What's new:**\[/b][/p][p]- You can now jump during a dash[/p][p]- You can now jump after falling off a ledge[/p][p]- Level timer now stops immediately when you enter a door in Story Mode[/p][p]- Music will now shift mid-level if you're taking too long[/p][p]- Masks now show which season they unlock in[/p][p]- Cutscenes now auto-advance[/p][p]- Fixed an issue with selecting random mask[/p][p]- Updated resolution settings for better compatibility[/p][p]- Removed some cheaters from the leaderboards[/p]

notes.title: HardAF Has Officially Launched！
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone! 🎉 *HardAF* is officially out now![/h3]

Release Content
[list]
[*] 60 pulse-pounding levels across 6 distinct worlds — each packed with deadly traps, brutal timing, relentless action plus 6 epic boss battles
[*] Local multiplayer madness — grab 2–4 friends and battle it out on the same screen
[*] A powerful level editor — craft your own stages and unleash them upon the global community
[*] Compete for glory on the leaderboards — how fast can you beat the pain?
[/list]

We’ve also partnered with two big titles for special bundle deals: 

[i]Strike Force Heroes[/i], [i]I Wanna Be the Creator[/i] and [i]Level Devil[/i].

Own either game and score an extra 10% off!

Strike Force Heroes + HardAF
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54955

Level Devil + HardAF
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54641

I Wanna Be the Creator + HardAF
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54640

But wait, there’s more, we’ve teamed up with three amazing Bilibili Streamers — their in-game likenesses appear as collectible masks!

Can you spot them all?

[h3]If you enjoy the game, we’d love it if you recommended *HardAF* to your friends — take on the challenge together![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2679880
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3748180

Bleed your way through each level. 
Unlock new chapters and masks. 
Sprint, jump, and dash through an unrelenting gauntlet of pain — all the way to the end!

📽 Also, don’t miss our official launch trailer — now live!
[previewyoutube=hsELGTejAOk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Get ready — HardAF drops June 5th at 8 AM (UTC-4）
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re super excited to let you know that HardA is launching on June 5th at 8 AM (UTC-4)!

💸 The price will be ＄7.99(with a juicy 20% launch discount — you deserve it).

🕹 What’s waiting for you at launch?
[list]
[*] 60 brutal, fast-paced levels across 6 chapters
[*] 
[*] 6 bosses that really don’t want you to win
[*] 
[*] Local multiplayer (2-4 players) 
[*] 
[*] Level editor — make your own crazy stages and share them with the world
[*] 
[*] Leaderboards — speedrunners and perfectionists, this one’s for you
[/list]

Paint the floor with your mistakes, unlock new chapters and masks, and keep dashing, jumping, and dying until you finally make it through. 😈

🎬 Check out the launch trailer here:
[previewyoutube=hsELGTejAOk;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

We’ve been pouring our heart, sweat, and a lot of retries into this, and we honestly can’t wait for you to try it out. Thanks so much to everyone who’s supported us so far — you're the reason this is happening.

If you’re excited (or just curious), please wishlist the game on Steam — it helps more than you think:
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2679880/_HardAF/

See you on the leaderboard. Or in the spikes.💀
